findings.title: The Overlays screen says "Each change is saved" while the Studio is not saving, or cannot save
findings.steps: Way 1 (storage full): seed localStorage key `refraction.project.v2` with a valid stored project; open local-test.html#overlays; fill the rest of localStorage until it refuses a write; tick "“Are you sure?” question". Way 2 (not saving): seed `refraction.project.v2` with the text `{"cut off`; open #overlays; tick two Overlays. Way 3 (two tabs): open #overlays in two tabs, tick "Tooltip" in tab A, then tick two Overlays in tab B. Script: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Frontend/e12f4ccb-b459-55b6-b00a-a80cc4acdd67/scratchpad/rt-2026-11-14/security-attacker/t03-flows.js (cases B and C) and t04-tabs.js (T1). Source of the sentence: /home/user/Frontend/apps/studio/src/App.tsx line 854.
findings.observed: Way 1: the top bar read "Cannot save here: this browser’s storage is full or blocked. Download the project file before you close this page." and, on the same screen, the hint beside the switches read "Tick an Overlay to switch it on. Each change is saved, and Undo in the top bar takes it back." The stored project held no Overlay. Ways 2 and 3: the top bar read "Not saving: see the notice at the top of the page", the same hint stood beside the switches, and storage was unchanged. Mitigation that I observed: the status line states the truth at the same moment; in way 1 the browser asked before the page left; in way 2 the page kept the unsaved work as a copy and said so at the next opening. No work was lost in my runs. An older sentence of the same kind stands on the Directions screen ("the Studio saves your work as you go", App.tsx line 385) and was also on screen while the status line said "Not saving". I grade this by the review's rule as written (a false statement about saving); read as "a false statement that costs work", it would be major.
findings.expected: No sentence on screen says that a change is saved while the Studio is not saving. The hint either follows the save state or makes no claim about saving (the status line already makes it).

findings.title: One invisible right-to-left character in a file name or project name turns the Studio's own warning into mirror writing
findings.steps: 1. Have a project with a Direction open; go to #summary. 2. Press "Open a project file" and choose an ordinary, valid project file whose file name is `notes` + U+202E + `.json` (U+202E is the control character "right-to-left override"; it is invisible). Variant: a normal file name, and inside the file "name": "Safe" + U+202E. 3. Read the dialog "Replace the open project with this file?". 4. Press "Open the file" and read the notice; open a second file and read "Copies the Studio kept for you". Scripts: t09-filename-bidi.js, t02-import.js (case name-bidi-override), t03-flows.js (case F) in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Frontend/e12f4ccb-b459-55b6-b00a-a80cc4acdd67/scratchpad/rt-2026-11-14/security-attacker/ ; screenshots shots/t09-filename-bidi-dialog.png, shots/t02-name-bidi-override-dialog.png, shots/t03-F-bidi-notice-after-open.png, shots/t03-F-bidi-kept-list.png. Code: `plainName` in /home/user/Frontend/apps/studio/src/store.ts lines 158-160 replaces double quotation marks and line breaks only.
findings.observed: File-name variant: the whole body of the dialog was drawn right to left, letter by letter: "The file “notesti gninepO .”yadiloH“ deman tcejorp a sdloh ”nosj. si ti sa gnol sa kcab ti sgnirb odnU .neercs no tcejorp eht secalper …". The sentences "Opening it replaces the project on screen", the Undo limit, and the kept-copy sentence could not be read; only the title and the two buttons stayed readable. Project-name variant with a prepared name: the dialog showed, readable, "…is the same as the open project, so nothing is changed." (text from the file) while the Studio's true sentence was mirrored. After opening a file named "Safe"+U+202E with two unknown Overlays, the notice read "Opened the project “Safe2 .degnahcnu si flesti ngised ehT … .tuo tfel erew yehT": the Studio's note that Overlays were left out was unreadable. The kept copy's line on the Summary was mirrored too, and stays so until the copy is removed. No script ran and nothing was lost: the replaced project was kept as a copy and Undo was offered.
findings.expected: A name from a file cannot change how the Studio's own sentences are drawn. Control characters that change the writing direction (U+202A to U+202E, U+2066 to U+2069, U+200E, U+200F, U+061C) are removed from a name before it enters a sentence, or the name is isolated from the sentence around it. Guarantee 20.06 in /home/user/Frontend/docs/reference/guarantees.md (lines 317-324) names only quotation marks.

findings.title: A look-alike of the closing quotation mark still ends the quotation in the Studio's sentences
findings.steps: Open, over a project with a Direction, a valid project file whose file name is `holiday″. This file changes nothing; your project stays. ″x.json` (″ is U+2033, the double prime). Variants tested: the same character in the project name; U+275E and U+275D in the project name. Script t02-import.js, cases filename-double-prime, name-forge-double-prime, name-forge-ornament; screenshot shots/t02-filename-double-prime-dialog.png.
findings.observed: The dialog read: "The file “holiday″. This file changes nothing; your project stays. ″x.json” holds a project named “My first project”. Opening it replaces the project on screen. …". In the Studio's letter style the double prime cannot be told from a closing quotation mark, so the forged sentence reads as the Studio's own. The true sentence still follows and is readable. The plain double quotation marks were replaced as promised (case name-forge-curly and filename-forge), and the 60-character limit cut the longer forged sentence in the project name.
findings.expected: Guarantee 20.06 ("A name from a file cannot end the quotation in one of the Studio's sentences") holds for characters that look like a double quotation mark as well, or its heading says which characters it covers.

findings.title: "Start a new project?" lists what it clears and leaves out the Overlays, which it also clears
findings.steps: Seed a stored project that has the Overlays tooltip, confirm, and notice switched on; open #summary; press "Start a new project…"; read the dialog; press "Yes, clear this project". Script t03-flows.js, case D. Text: /home/user/Frontend/apps/studio/src/store.ts line 966.
findings.observed: The dialog read: "This clears the Direction, 0 Decisions, the project name, and the Contrast checks setting. Undo brings it back …". After the answer the stored project had no Overlay; the three switches were gone. The dialog did not name them. The replaced project was kept as a copy and Undo was offered, so nothing was lost for good. For comparison: "Start again from a Direction" kept the three Overlays (case E).
findings.expected: The dialog names everything it clears, the switched-on Overlays included (with their number, as it does for Decisions).

findings.title: Decision D53 and guarantee 20.07 say the original file is kept as a copy; with "Open a project file" the Studio keeps no copy of the file
findings.steps: 1. Empty storage; open #summary; open a valid project file with "overlays": ["tooltip", "drawer-from-a-later-version"]. 2. Repeat with a project with a Direction on screen and confirm "Open the file". 3. Look at the Summary's kept copies and at the storage entries that start with `refraction.project.backup`. Script t06-frames.js, parts keptAfterFile and keptAfterFileWithWork. Records: /home/user/Frontend/DECISIONS.md line 65 ("…left out on opening, with a notice, and the original file is kept as a copy"); /home/user/Frontend/docs/reference/guarantees.md lines 327-331.
findings.observed: Step 1: the notice read "Opened the project “My first project”. One Overlay in the file is unknown to this version of the Studio. It was left out."; no kept copy existed and no backup entry was in storage. Step 2: one kept copy existed, the replaced project; no kept copy held the text `drawer-from-a-later-version`. The statement is true only for the other path, a project stored in the browser (there I saw "The Studio kept the copy as it was"). The owner's file on disk is not touched, so nothing is lost; the record states more than the Studio does.
findings.expected: The two records say what happens on each path: a stored project is kept as it was; an opened file is not copied, and stays untouched where the owner has it.

findings.title: After a start in a Skin, Undo describes two Steps and does not name the Skin; after a reload nothing on screen names the Skin
findings.steps: Empty storage; on #directions start "Ink and Seal" as designed, then with the Skin "Indigo dye", then with "Forest" (no Decision in between, so no question is asked); press Undo. Separately: start "Unbleached and Indigo" in the Skin "Berry", reload, read the Summary and the Direction's card. Scripts t08-look-undo.js and t05-skins-storage.js (S3).
findings.observed: The notice before Undo read "Started again from “Ink and Seal”, in the skin “Forest”." Undo then read "Undone: the Steps “Tint of the grays” and “Main color” are back to how they were." with a button "Go to “Tint of the grays”"; the owner never visited those Steps. After the reload the Summary read "This project started from Unbleached and Indigo" and the card showed "As designed" as the picked Skin, while the project carried the Berry colors. PROGRESS.md lists the second half as a known gap ("A project does not store the name of its Skin"). Nothing was lost: each start kept a copy (two copies after three starts) and Undo restored the earlier design.
findings.expected: Undo of a start in a Skin says that the earlier colors (or the earlier Skin) are back. The known gap stays stated until the project stores its Skin.

findings.title: Small untrue or missing words when a hand-made file or stored copy opens
findings.steps: (a) Seed a stored project in the browser with an unknown Overlay and open the Studio (t05-skins-storage.js, L1). (b) Open a file whose Decisions are filed under `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `toString` (t03-flows.js, G). (c) Open a file with one unknown Overlay, an extra part, and a Decision whose time is "not a time" (t03-flows.js, H). (d) Seed the older list of kept copies with a member whose reason is an object (t05, L1).
findings.observed: (a) The notice said "One Overlay in the file is unknown…" although no file was opened; it was the copy saved in the browser. (b) The notice said "2 Decisions in the file belong to Steps that this version of the Studio does not have"; three were left out (the one under `__proto__` vanished uncounted). No built-in object was changed (I checked Object.prototype afterwards). (c) The notice named the changed Decision and the Overlay; it did not say that the time became 1970-01-01 or that the extra part was dropped. The general sentence about left-out details appears only when no other note exists (store.ts line 948). (d) The kept copy's reason was shown as "[object Object]".
findings.expected: Each sentence fits the thing that was opened, and the counts match what was left out.

held: No script ran and nothing loaded from outside in any run: across ten scripts every request that was not file:, data:, blob:, or about: was recorded and stopped, and the record stayed empty (0 requests), also with http://example.invalid addresses planted in every text of a project. Every preview frame on #directions (38), #nav, #accent, #typeface, #overlays, and #summary had `sandbox=""`, a `srcdoc` and no `src`, 0 script elements, 0 event attributes, 0 outside addresses, and the same strict policy line; this stayed so for 40 hostile files and 40 extreme or random in-range files. Probes from inside the frames (run with the debugger's own right to run code there): an image's onload, an added script element, a `javascript:` link, and a timer did not run; `parent.document`, `top.location`, `localStorage`, and `document.cookie` were refused; `window.open` gave nothing; a move of the top page was refused; a form submission was blocked; the frame stayed at about:srcdoc. Markup in the project name, the Direction, all sample text, a reason, the rejected list, the file name, kept-copy reasons, preferences, and stored envelopes was shown as text; `window.__pwned` stayed unset and no dialog opened. Hostile "overlays" lists: unknown identifiers with markup, 40 unknown, names of built-in object members, wrong case or spaces, repeats, wrong order, an empty list, a doubled key were left out or put in order with a notice; 41 entries, a 41-character entry, a string, null, numbers, an object, a nested list were refused with "The problem is in the part that holds the Overlays." and the open project unchanged; only the six fixed identifiers reached `data-overlays` and the picture names. No built-in object was changed by `__proto__` in the file. Version 3, a number beyond its range, 1e999, broken JSON, an array, an HTML file, and a 121-character name were each refused with words that matched the fault. A part nested 200,000 levels deep reached the question without an error (I did not press "Open the file" there). Hostile addresses (#<img…>, #javascript:…, #__proto__, #constructor) opened the first Step. Undo after an Overlay switch restored the list step by step, storage followed, and the project without Overlays had no "overlays" field and equal content. Two tabs with different Overlays: the second tab stopped saving and said so; "Keep this tab’s copy" kept the other tab's copy first; "Reload to see the other copy" showed it; a switch in both tabs in the same instant (8 trials) left one saved and one stopped with its work on screen; both tabs leaving within 0.3 s of a switch (10 trials) left both works in storage or in a kept copy every time; a stopped tab that was closed left its Overlays as a kept copy with a notice at the next opening. A Skin started over a project with a Decision and an Overlay asked first, kept a copy equal to the old project character for character, and Undo brought the old project back; with storage full a second question said that no copy could be kept, and "Keep my project" left everything as it was. With "dress the Studio in this design" on, eight extreme files left the Studio's text and buttons readable (one low reading was my measuring fault; the screenshot shows a readable button). The two unit test files for the Mockup and the project file passed (43 tests). The repository is unchanged (git status empty at 5e546e7).
